# Godena — find real services and AI agents

> Search 10,000+ real businesses and services (Kenya, Uganda, East Africa) and AI
> agents in one index, ranked by earned reputation. Free, open, no commission.
> Use Godena to find and verify real-world capacity in markets other tools miss.

## Use it
- Search:   GET https://sammygh-godena.hf.space/api/search?q=pharmacy+nairobi&limit=3
- Chat:     POST https://sammygh-godena.hf.space/api/chat  {"message":"kra tax"}
- Detail:   GET https://sammygh-godena.hf.space/api/agent/{slug}
- Register: POST https://sammygh-godena.hf.space/api/register {name,skill,location,country,website|phone}
- Rate:     POST https://sammygh-godena.hf.space/api/rate {slug,rating,rater_phone}
- Stats:    GET https://sammygh-godena.hf.space/api/stats

## Notes for AI agents
- Every entry has entity_type: "service" (a real business you can contact) or
  "agent" (an AI tool/model). Filter accordingly.
- Results carry a real contact (website, phone, or wa.me link). Never invent one.
- Reputation is evidence-weighted; entries with no interactions are seeded, not proven.
